summary: Iteration 43 — Combined validation of (1) BUG FIX for GET /api/submit-link/a/{assignment_id}/w/{week_number} + `/submit/a/:assignmentId/w/:week` frontend route, and (2) NEW feature 'Submit for student' on assignment milestones (POST /api/milestones/{milestone_id}/submit-on-behalf endpoint + SubmitOnBehalfMilestoneDialog UI). Full pass, 0 regressions. Created new focused test suite /app/backend/tests/test_submit_on_behalf_milestone.py (15 tests / 3 classes). ALL 15 PASS. BUG FIX verified: (a) 200 with full assignment+milestone metadata (title, description, submission_type, feedback_template, drive_folder_url, questionnaire_fields, milestone_id, week_number, is_final_capstone, etc.) for a valid asgn+week, (b) 404 for a nonexistent assignment_id, (c) 404 for a week with no milestone ('No milestone for week 99…'), (d) endpoint is truly public (no Authorization header → still 200). NEW endpoint verified: (a) 401 without auth, (b) 404 for missing assignment / missing milestone / unknown student, (c) 400 for student-not-enrolled, (d) 400 for wrong file extension (pitch rejects .pdf, error lists allowed extensions), (e) 400 for missing file on file-based type, (f) 200 successful submit — Mongo doc persists with correct student_id + assignment_id + milestone_id + cohort_id + file_name + submission_type + submitted_by (instructor), (g) idempotent resubmit — same student+milestone reuses submission_id, resubmission_count increments, only 1 doc in DB, (h) auto AI review helper triggered — polled up to 40s: ai_feedback populated and status='draft' (real GPT-5.2 call via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, no mocking). REGRESSION suite from iter42 baseline: 149/149 pass (test_refactor_iter42 + test_milestone_titles + test_assignments_phase1 + test_assignments_phase2 + test_assignment_templates + test_rubric_library + test_submission_types + this new suite). Additional: 79/79 pass on test_super_admin + test_drive_link + test_feedback_template + test_global_materials + test_duplicate_endpoints + test_submit_link (legacy material-based). Legacy POST /api/materials/{material_id}/submit-on-behalf regression confirmed — still returns 401 without auth (auto-review closure untouched, only new helper `_run_auto_ai_review_for_submission` was added). FRONTEND (Playwright, super_admin, cohort_3a1999cb7d72 → Fall 2024 Leadership): navigated to /cohort/{id}, opened Assignments tab (4 cards render: 60-Second Elevator Pitch / Kawasaki 10-Slide Pitch Deck / ShiftSure Case Activity / Business Questionnaire — all with `assignment-card-{id}` testids). Expanded 60-Second Pitch: found 14 `submit-on-behalf-milestone-{milestone_id}` buttons (one per week milestone), all visible. Expanded Business Questionnaire — total SOB button count STAYED at 14 → questionnaire correctly hides the button ✅. Clicked first SOB button: dialog `submit-on-behalf-milestone-dialog` opened with all 4 sub-testids (`sob-student-select`, `sob-file-input`, `sob-submit-btn`, plus the info banner about auto-review). Submit button correctly disabled initially (no student, no file). File input `accept` attribute = 'video/*,audio/*,.mp4,.mov,.m4v,.mp3,.m4a,.wav' — matches pitch config. Opened student dropdown: 7 options (`sob-student-option-{student_id}`) matching cohort's 7 students. No console errors. Total: **228/228 backend tests pass, 100% frontend UI verification pass**. No fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4013-4168 `_run_auto_ai_review_for_submission` helper is a clean extraction of the auto-review closure from the legacy `/materials/.../submit-on-behalf` handler. Signature is keyword-only for all optional args (good defensive style). Reads submission fresh from DB — correctly supports both file-based (via read_file_text/GridFS) and questionnaire (via _questionnaire_text_from_doc). One nit: the helper swallows the LLM exception on line 4167 with only a logger.error — if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY quota is exhausted, the submission stays in 'pending' status with no user-visible signal. Consider persisting status='review_failed' + error_message so the instructor UI can surface it. Non-blocking.

server.py:4171-4345 POST /milestones/{milestone_id}/submit-on-behalf validates in the right order (assignment → milestone → cohort_manager → student → student-enrolled → extension). Idempotency via (student_id, assignment_id, milestone_id, cohort_id) composite key is correct. Uses `asyncio.create_task(...)` for the auto-review (fire-and-forget) — this is fine on a single-worker Uvicorn but if you later scale to multiple workers, the task may die when the request-serving worker is recycled. For hardening, consider a proper task queue (Celery/Arq/Dramatiq) or FastAPI BackgroundTasks with a persistent job table. Non-blocking for MVP.

server.py:4238-4251 file extension check falls back to DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS if the submission_type isn't in SUBMISSION_TYPE_CONFIG. Good defensive default. Consider also validating file size (Content-Length) to prevent DOS via huge uploads — currently unbounded. Non-blocking.

DirectSubmit.js:322-341 The bugfix (no more /api/cohorts/{id}/assignments call) is verified by test_valid_returns_full_metadata_public — the enriched resolver response now contains everything the submit UI needs (assignment.title, description, submission_type, questionnaire_fields, drive_folder_url, milestone.title, drive_folder_url_override, week_number). Frontend now depends on ONE public endpoint instead of TWO (public + auth-guarded), so a non-enrolled instructor can no longer 403 on page load. The enforcement moves entirely to POST submit time, which is the correct security posture (public read + authoritative write).

SubmitOnBehalfMilestoneDialog.js:47 correctly reads getSubmissionTypeConfig(assignment.submission_type) to derive the accept attribute — verified live: for 60_second_pitch the accept is 'video/*,audio/*,.mp4,.mov,.m4v,.mp3,.m4a,.wav'. The `isQuestionnaire` short-circuit at line 48 renders a friendly warning banner instead of the form — nice defensive UX in case the dialog is ever mounted from a code path that doesn't filter questionnaire (currently it's filtered at the button level in AssignmentsTab.js:223, but the double-guard is good).

AssignmentsTab.js:223-233 the `asgn.submission_type !== 'business_questionnaire'` guard is inline with the button render, which keeps the intent explicit and testable. `submit-on-behalf-milestone-{milestone_id}` testid pattern is consistent with other per-milestone testids (copy-milestone-link-, edit-milestone-). Good.

Test suite: test_submit_on_behalf_milestone.py uses `TEST_SOB_` prefix + module-scoped seed fixture with proper teardown (delete_many with regex prefix on users, sessions, cohorts, assignments, submissions). Zero production data mutation. Reuses the same seeded instructor session token for all endpoint tests — efficient.
